notes.title: Patch notes 1.1 22/06/2022
notes.notes:
[h3]NEW FEATURES / IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]

•  Fractured premonition mode now allows to play all discovered levels and the next 3 levels even if they have not been discovered yet in adventure mode.
•  Added a gauge on the main screen indicating the number of levels available in the fractured premonition mode.
•  Fixed and improved lighting throughout the game.
•  Improved dynamic shadows.
•  Option for automatic climb (on by default).
•  Added option to disable volumetric fog.
•  Added a general slider for optimization/quality.
•  Improved cursor precision in the menus.
•  Improved ragdolls.
•  William's left arm is now a ragdoll.
•  Improved William's crystal material.
•  William now moves 20% faster.
•  Improved walking and climbing animations without a lantern.
•  Corrections on the gypsy cousins' sentences and improvement of tony's dialogues.
•  New lamp models have been added.
•  Improved display of clues and acts.
•  Improved and added text for skeletons.
•  Visual improvement of mirror snap blocks.
•  Improved display of joystick controls in the interface.
•  Improved animations with lanterns.
•  Various interface optimizations.



[h3]SOUNDS [/h3]
•  Improved climbing sound.
•  Added sound alteration during speed acceleration.
•  Added new music for various levels.
•  The sound dialogues time of the pnj is shorter.


[h3]BUG FIXES [/h3]

•  Fixed a bug preventing vermin from interacting properly with lasers.

[h3]TEXTS AND LOCATION [/h3]

•  Improved dialogue from Vos Helsing, Jonathan Harker and Tony.

notes.title: Patch notes 20/01/2022
notes.notes:
[h3]NEW FEATURES / IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
• Added the ability to make lateral movements with the 3rd person camera to allow the player to choose their preferred configuration.
• Updated controls in the in-game interface.
• Improved William's animations with the lantern.

[h3]SOUNDS [/h3]
• New music has been added for The Occult Wing.

notes.title: Patch notes 11/01/2022
notes.notes:
[h3]NEW FEATURES / IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
• William now automatically climbs obstacles. This option can be disabled in the menus.
• William is now faster.
• Improved William's walking and climbing animations without a lantern.
• Improved William's arm model.
• The camera moves faster in third person.

[h3]SOUNDS [/h3]
• William's climbing sound has been improved.
• Music has been added for the Suspended Greenhouses, the Clock Tower and the Imperial Canal areas.
• Sounds are accelerated when the player speeds up time.
• Added a gramophone sound for time acceleration.

[h3]TEXT AND LOCALISATION[/h3]
• Improved and added text for talking skeletons.

notes.title: Patch notes 01/04/2022
notes.notes:
[h3]NEW FEATURES / IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
• William's model Improvement.
• Slight changes have been made to improve the understanding of The Promenade of the Impaled.
• Talking skulls have been added in a large part of the game.
• Skeletons now walk around in some areas of the game.
• Texts in dialogue bubbles is more condensed.
• Added texts and elements explaining the history of the castle in different areas of the game.
• Money is displayed more accurately.
• The different levels of the white wolf are now more understandable.

[h3]SOUNDS [/h3]
• Added sound for falling crates.

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
• Fixed a bug that prevented the game from loading properly after a death.
• Fixed bugs in the display of streams.
• Fixed a bug adding ghost memories in the menu.
• Fixed various issues that prevented some achievements from being obtained correctly.

[h3]TEXT AND LOCALIZATION[/h3]
• Improved some translations for the white wolf and the skeletons.

notes.title: Patch notes 12/23/2021
notes.notes:
[h3]NEW FEATURES / IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
• Adjustment of various cables linking mecanisms for better readability of areas.
• The not obtained plans shadows are displayed to allow a better understanding of the castle maps completion.
• Improved the castle plans.
• Improved the different texts fonts.
• Improved of the camera movement when wiliam is drowning.
• Improved the navigation between the cards in combat.
• Improved the light in the mausoleum.
• Improved the luminosity option management.
• Post process global improvement.

[h3]SOUNDS [/h3]
• Add soundst for Wiliam's movements.
• Improvement of the balance between sound effects and music.
• Adjustment of the bats sound.

[h3]BUGS FIXES[/h3]
• Fixed a bug that prevented the puzzle steles to save correctly.
• Fixed some water that had the wrong color.
• Fixed a bug that caused "missing string" to appear in memories.
• Fixed a sound problem on sailing platforms.

[h3]TEXT AND LOCALIZATION[/h3]
• Corrections and adjustment of various texts in French and English.

notes.title: Patch notes 12/14/2021
notes.notes:
[h3]NEW FEATURES / IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
• Added hints about the objectives to be achieved in the pause menu.
• Improved the font.
• "Quit game" buttons are now clearer about their function.
• Added a lantern position indicator on the map.
• Souls are now only visible on maps after meeting Grigori.
• Updated William's animations when he is standing still with the lantern.
• Shadows on missing maps are now visible.
• Added a delay to prevent closing a dialogue immediately after it appears.
• Added an achievement when obtaining the lantern.
• New image for the Kalle Haraldson achievement.
• Added achievements for 100% completion of different areas of the game.
• Added a tip to make dialogue bubbles more understandable.

• Demo update.

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
• Fixed a bug that prevented the laser from rotating in the underground river.
• It is no longer possible to pass through jellies when they are blocked.

notes.title: Patch notes 12/07/2021
notes.notes:
[h3]NEW FEATURES / IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
• Added clues to indicate the different keys the player can use at the beginning of the game.
• Global improvements to help the understanding of the first area.
• New font to improve the readability of text.
• Improved puzzle navigation using a pushable sphere in the museum of horrors.
• Added a path to improve navigation in the eastern part of the Swamps.
• Improved the player's path through the triple stream room in the inner moat.
• Improved controller navigation during combat.
• Improved readability of clues on maps.
• New pictures for NPC Steam achievements.
• The lantern can now speed up time.

[h3]SOUNDS [/h3]
• Added an activation sound for electrical objects.
• The Northern Laboratory opponent now patrols correctly again.
• Improved the wind plateforms sounds .

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
• Fixed a bug where the player could fall through the floor in the hunting lodge
• The names of the areas are now correctly displayed in the pause menu.
• Pushable crates can no longer overlap each other.
• Fixed a bug where more than 6 items could be in the inventory.

notes.title: Patch notes 12/03/2021
notes.notes:
[h3]NEW FEATURES / IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
• Giant Rat animation speed has been increased.
• Vermin now dive into a burrow instead of just disappearing.
• Added animated skeletons in all areas of the game.
• Swamp rafts have been improved to get stuck less often.
• Added hints to blocks containing animal parts to better understand their direction.
• The interface is better adapted to different screen sizes.
• Improved visibility of water in pipes.
• Optimised the effects of wind corridors.
• Optimised performance in the interface.

[h3]SOUNDS[/h3]
• Improved lock sounds.
• Added new ambient and battle music.
• The organ has a new sound for its notes.
• Sail chariots have new sounds.
• Vermin's sound has been improved.

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
• Fixed a bug that prevented solving puzzles involving currents in the second part of the inner moat.
• Changed the collision of the skull sphere to match the object correctly.
• The sphere can no longer be trapped under a scale in the cloak wing.
• Fixed a bug allowing to cross jellies without making them move.
• Fixed a camera bug at the end of the fight that always returned to first person.
• Fixed a bug that caused crates to fall when they were on the dispensers.

notes.title: Patch notes 11/30/2021
notes.notes:

• Visual update of canopy beds.
• Visual update of the organ in the Little Opera area.
• Improved player controls with a new movement system.
• Added areas percentage of complexion.
• Added percentage of memories recovered.

• William's spin speed has been increased.

[list]
[*] FOV choice.
[*] Vertical synchronization.
[*] Dynamic shadows management.
[*] Full screen.
[/list]

• Added marks for the objects and keys locations in the inventory.


[h3]SOUNDS[/h3]
• Improved sounds of various puzzle:
[list]
[*] Sliding puzzle
[*] Tesla coils
[*] Rubik's Cube
[*] Sand yachting
[*] Harrows
[*] Traps
[/list]
• Added 4 new musics.
• Improved lantern sounds.
• Monsters now have their own music in combat.

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
• The elevators allowing access to the map in the smelly oubliette are works properly again.
• Player 2 can no longer jump when the menu is open.

[h3]TEXTS AND LOCATION[/h3]
• Correction of the French tooltip of the button " resume the adventure".

notes.title: Patch notes 11/26/2021

notes.title: MVOL release
notes.notes:
[h1]What an exceptional moment! [/h1]

We're very proud to announce the [b]release of MVOL on Steam[/b]! 
And to celebrate [b]MVOL[/b] is [b]40% off[/b] during the [b]autumn sales on Steam[/b]! 

It has been a long and perilous journey of 4 passionate years of work and we hope you'll enjoy playing [b]MVOL[/b] as much as we do!
